title: bengali-postocr-sllm: zero-shot small-language-model post-correction of historical Bengali OCR
description: Code, frozen page lists, prompts, analysis scripts and numeric summaries for a study of zero-shot post-correction of historical Bengali OCR (40 pages of the REID2019 British Library ground truth, Tesseract and EasyOCR) with small open language models, a dictionary baseline, a fine-tuning pilot and a large model. Per-page OCR text and model outputs are not included unless released separately.
